title: Live
no-more: That is everything from the last 7 days.
empty: All quiet. Write the first message.
mute-reason: Reason (shown to everyone in the chat and kept in the log)
block.no-privilege: You are not allowed to write in the chat.
block.muted: You are muted in the chat until %1. Reason: %2
block.muted-perm: You are permanently muted in the chat. Reason: %1
block.email: Confirm your email address to write in the chat.
block.age: You can write %1 hours after signing up.
block.posts: Write at least %1 post on the forum to use the chat.
error.no-privilege: You are not allowed to write in the chat.
error.muted: You are muted in the chat.
error.email: Confirm your email address to write in the chat.
error.age: Your account is too new to write in the chat.
error.posts: Write a post on the forum first.
error.too-long: A message can have at most %1 characters.
error.too-many-lines: The message has too many lines.
error.links-rank: Links are allowed from rank level %1.
error.links-posts: Links are allowed after %1 forum posts.
error.rate-limit: Slow down a little. Try again in %1 s.
error.mute-reason: Give a reason for the mute.
widget.title: Live
widget.acp-help: Shows the 3 latest messages and opens the chat.
acp.title: Chat name
acp.title-help: Shown in the dock header, on the launcher button and in the widget. Leave empty to use the translated default ("Live" in English, "Na żywo" in Polish).
acp.link-rank: Links from rank level (with nodebb-plugin-rank-badges; 0 = everyone)
acp.link-posts: Links from forum posts (without nodebb-plugin-rank-badges; 0 = everyone)
acp.fixed: Fixed limits: %1 characters per message, %2 messages on open, kept for %3 days or %4 messages.
acp.privileges: Who reads, writes and moderates: ACP → Privileges → Global (Shoutbox: read / write / moderate). Administrators and global moderators can always moderate.
update.private: update it with the deployment script
update.check-help: Once a day the forum fetches the latest version number of this plugin from updates.wirelab.pl: a plain GET request, nothing about the forum is sent. When this is off, no requests are made.
